tokens.name: color-bg
tokens.usage: The ground of a page and the fill of tiles that sit on a card. Text on it: `color-text` (14.9:1) or `color-neutral-700` (5.9:1).

tokens.name: color-surface
tokens.usage: Cards, dialogs and inputs, always on `color-bg`. Text on it: `color-text` (17.5:1) or `color-neutral-700` (7:1).

tokens.name: color-text
tokens.usage: Body and heading text on `color-bg`, `color-surface` and the light tints. Same value as `color-ink` in the light theme; pale #e8eef3 in the dark theme (13:1 on `color-surface`).

tokens.name: color-accent
tokens.usage: The navy of the main action: primary buttons, links, the focus ring, selected tabs and checked boxes. Put `color-bg` text on it (10.9:1). Dark theme: a pale steel (#b9c6d6) so the main action stays the brightest control; text on it is still `color-bg` (9.6:1).

tokens.name: color-accent-2
tokens.usage: The logo cyan. "You are here" on the ink frame (with `color-ink` text, 7.2:1), the "all good" tint through its `100` step, accents on dark. Never as text on a light ground.

tokens.name: color-divider
tokens.usage: Hairlines and control borders: ink at 16%. Table rules, card edges, input borders. As a control border it is 1.4:1 on `color-surface`, below the 3:1 minimum, so keep a visible label on every field.

tokens.name: color-ink
tokens.usage: The dark frame: sidebars, top bars and tab bars, and small marks that need to stand out on light. Text on it: white, `color-neutral-200` or `color-accent-2-300` (all 9:1 or better). Same value as `color-text`. Dark theme: a step darker than `color-bg` (#060d17) so the frame still reads as a frame.

tokens.name: color-warn
tokens.usage: The amber of the logo's beak: something needs attention (missing, low, pending). A fill or accent only; use `color-warn-800` for text.

tokens.name: color-warn-100
tokens.usage: Tinted background for attention tags and cells. Text on it: `color-warn-800` (6.5:1) or `color-text`.

tokens.name: color-warn-800
tokens.usage: Text on `color-warn-100`.

tokens.name: color-danger
tokens.usage: Errors only, on `color-danger-100` (5.8:1). Never use it for "low" or "missing": that is `color-warn`.

tokens.name: color-danger-100
tokens.usage: Background of an error message. Text: `color-danger`.

tokens.name: color-text-secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary text: ledes, hints, field labels, table meta. 5.9:1 on `color-bg` in light, 7.8:1 on `color-surface` in dark. Use this rather than a ramp step so it follows the theme.

tokens.name: color-border-control
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, textareas and checkboxes: 4.5:1 on `color-surface` in light, 3.6:1 in dark, above the 3:1 control edges need.

tokens.name: color-on-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `color-ink` (the top bar, the sidebar), in both themes.

tokens.name: color-on-ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on `color-ink`: section labels in a sidebar, captions (9.3:1).

tokens.name: color-accent-pressed

tokens.name: color-neutral-100
tokens.usage: Cool grey ramp on the ink hue, 100 to 900. 100: tile fills and the neutral tag. 200: the page ground and text on dark. 300-400: rules and dividers. 500: checkbox borders. 700: secondary text on light (5.9:1 on `color-bg`). 800: text inside tinted cells. 900: the ink.

styles.name: display-number
styles.usage: Big numerals: counts and totals. Barlow Condensed 800.

styles.name: heading-page
styles.usage: One per screen: the page title. Always uppercase. 30px on a phone.

styles.name: heading-4
styles.usage: Default `h4`; small titles and numerals inside components. Uppercase.

styles.name: body-lede
styles.usage: The sentence under a page title, at most 52 characters wide, in `color-neutral-700`.
styles.sample: Une phrase qui présente la page.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: The main label of a row or a list item.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Field labels and hints, in `color-text` at 55-70% (see the contrast note in the README).

styles.name: label-caps
styles.usage: Eyebrows (in `color-accent-700`) and small labels. Uppercase, tracked.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Hairline gaps: between a label and its field, inside tight icon buttons.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between related controls (buttons in a row, tags) and the vertical padding of a button.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between items in a list or a card.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Standard card and dialog padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Padding of large cards and the gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Screen padding and the gap between page-level blocks.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Small tiles that sit tight to a grid.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Inner tiles and the base for cards.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Panels and tiles inside a card; the base of the card radius.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Cards and dialogs: `radius-lg` x 1.15 (32.2px).

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Every small control is a pill: buttons, tags, inputs, tabs, navigation items, segmented controls.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Resting cards, the default.

tokens.name: shadow-md

tokens.name: shadow-lg
